notes.headline: Evidence beats similarity: the faulty function is ranked first in 85% of incidents
notes.detection: Thresholds only caught error faults: latency rose to 85-400 ms, under a 500 ms alert. The price of sensitivity: 2 of 6 quiet controls raised an incident.
notes.localization: Plain RAG + LLM 46%, BM25 18%, dense 15%. LLM re-rank: 82% Top-1 but best file Top-1 (91%).
notes.ablation: Deploy diff (-24 pts) and call graph (-18 pts) carry the ranking. Removing BM25 or dense alone raises Top-1 to 91%: text similarity adds noise once structure is known.
notes.action: 0 code fixes proposed on 9 control runs. Wrong 8/45: F09 undetected (3), F07 left as investigate (2), 2 false incidents marked investigate, 1 H03 surge missed.
limits_p1: F09 lock contention never detected: +4 ms per reservation at 3 workers is under the floors
2 of 6 quiet controls alarmed: /pay is bursty after a restart
Needs a known change time (deploy or traffic shift)
z = 6 and the floors were set by hand on seed 0
limits_p2: F07: the fault is a module-level regex; the LLM named the function that uses it
F06: a decoy edit in config.py on the call path outranked the real change once
BM25 and dense add noise when structure already decides
Python only; call graph links names, not types
limits_p3: Single-threaded tests cannot show lock contention
gpt-5.4-mini returned an empty answer 3 times (no test); gpt-oss-120b tests often failed the known-good code too
Latency tests near a budget can flip under machine load
Known-good = fault commit reverted; latent bugs have no such version
conclusions: Robust, change-aware detection found 92% of faults vs 33% for fixed thresholds, at 2 false incidents in 6 quiet runs
Hybrid tracing: 85% Top-1 vs 36% blame-deploy, 46% plain RAG + LLM, 3% v0
Generated tests confirmed the diagnosis in 94% (template) and 91% (LLM) of detected faults
82% right actions vs 13% for scale-on-alert; no code fix proposed on any control

example.title: F05: a config change made payments slow
example.detect: payments, POST /pay p95 55 ms -> 401 ms, z = 125, 20 of 20 buckets. Thresholds: silent (under 500 ms).
example.trace: Top-1: payments/config.py module block. Changed by "Be more patient with the card gateway" and read on the /pay call path (depth 2). Confidence 1.0. LLM agrees (0.91): slow gateway path matches ~400 ms requests.
example.confirm: LLM test: 60 POST /pay calls, p95 <= 111 ms. Faulty code: 403 ms, assertion fails. Known-good code: passes. Confirming.
example.handoff: Recommended action code_fix, owner team-payments. No change made; waiting for a named approver.
example.audit: detect -> context (packet 94d8107f) -> trace hybrid -> trace hybrid+llm (gpt-5.4-mini, 3.3k tokens, 10.5 s) -> test template -> test llm -> handoff: awaiting human approval
